hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts allowance for doubtful accounts falling as a share of receivables, with non-declining revenue and liquid SPY-relative leadership, may identify cleaner sales-quality candidates than raw DSO before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260616-021 rejected raw annual DSO but explicitly required materially different collection-quality evidence such as allowance or write-off normalization. The raw Companyfacts coverage check found broad allowance tag availability, but the economic interpretation is low-confidence because falling reserves can also mean under-reserving.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC allowance, receivables, or annual revenue facts; missing matching fiscal-year ends; stale facts; missing CIK mapping; missing OHLCV; missing next open; or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC allowance, receivables, and revenue filed-date PIT mapping, allowance-burden improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
